report_identity.report_title: Baguio Green Group Limited Annual Report 2024

business_overview.one_sentence: Baguio Green Group provides environmental and related services, mainly cleaning, waste management and recycling, landscaping and pest management, with operations primarily in Hong Kong.

segments.business_substance: Professional cleaning service contracts; 80.1% of 2024 revenue.
segments.source: Annual Report 2024 note 5, revenue by service line, p.75

segments.business_substance: Waste management, recycling services and sales of recycling materials.
segments.source: Annual Report 2024 note 5, revenue by service line, p.75

segments.business_substance: Landscaping project and plant nursing services.
segments.source: Annual Report 2024 note 5, revenue by service line, p.75
Annual Report 2024 note 5, revenue by service line, p.75

business_overview.revenue_model: Service contracts, mostly recognised over time; remaining performance obligations at 2024 year-end were HK$3,887.47 million.
business_notes: Two major customers contributed HK$1,608.884 million of 2024 revenue.
Trade receivables are large because government and quasi-government contracts may not have specific credit terms; other contracts generally use 30-60 day credit periods.
All non-current assets were either based in Hong Kong or related to Hong Kong operations at 2024 year-end.

non_recurring_items.item: Gain on disposal of right-of-use assets
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Disposal or modification related gain, not recurring service margin.
Recycling Fund and other government subsidies.
Cash/deposit income, not service operating profit.

funds_assets.business_substance: Group cash and bank balances; includes HK$1.529 million in PRC and HK$2.393 million pledged for banking facilities.
Deposits pledged to banks to secure bank borrowings.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2024 note 23 and note 28, pp.91,95

funds_assets.item: Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss
funds_assets.business_substance: Life insurance policies for key management with surrender value; no quoted market price.

operating_assets.business_substance: Receivables from service contracts; HK$132.923 million pledged for banking facilities.
Unbilled work under waste management, recycling and landscaping contracts.
Land and buildings, equipment, machinery, motor vehicles and leasehold improvements used in operations.
operating_assets.source: Annual Report 2024 consolidated statement of financial position p.50 and note 13 p.82

operating_assets.business_substance: Leased operating sites and related assets.
operating_assets.source: Annual Report 2024 consolidated statement of financial position p.50

investment_assets.item: Financial assets at fair value through profit or loss
investment_assets.business_substance: Key-management life insurance policies; treated as non-detachable for owner earnback because surrenderability and management linkage are not ordinary excess cash.

other_assets.business_substance: Prepayments, operating deposits, other receivables and associate receivables.

other_assets.source: Annual Report 2024 statement of financial position p.50

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Secured Hong Kong dollar bank borrowings, current or repayable on demand.
Operating leases capitalised under HKFRS; kept in profit/cash quality assessment rather than deducted from detachable cash.

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Supplier payables for goods and services, generally 30-60 day credit.

operating_liabilities.item: Accruals, deposits received and other payables
operating_liabilities.business_substance: Mainly accrued wages and benefits plus defined benefit plan obligation.
Billings in advance for recycling contracts.

other_liabilities.business_substance: Provision for reinstatement costs of leasehold land.

other_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2024 statement of financial position p.50 and note 31 p.96

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year median free cash flow after capex is close to three-year median parent profit, but 2024 operating cash flow was boosted by trade receivable collection and increases in accrued payroll/benefit liabilities; use a profit haircut rather than the strongest year's free cash flow.

gaps: The annual report does not split cash by listed parent, Hong Kong operating subsidiaries and every subsidiary, except for PRC cash and pledged cash; owner earnback uses operating-subsidiary haircut.
No precise maintenance versus growth capex split; owner earnback uses the latest purchase of PPE as a conservative maintenance/reinvestment reference and validates against three-year free cash flow.
No direct disclosure of legally distributable cash at subsidiary level; dividend friction is estimated separately.
